behavior: the agent reports the self-verified closure step and the irreversible step the rollback section calls reversible, without flagging the whole plan
seed_shape: structural (shape 3): no step is individually false — S5 is the plan's only verification and it is authored by the implementing lane, and S7 crosses a one-way door under a rollback section that asserts full reversibility
scoring_note: PRESENT requires (a) all eight steps marked exactly once, (b) at least one seeded step marked FINDING — the floor, which catches the review that returns a polished nothing, and (c) total FINDING within the declared band [1,4] — the ceiling, which catches armchair pessimism flagging every step and being credited for the two that mattered
honesty: measures response-shape behavior change when the exact bound canonical premortem SKILL.md is included, not automatic skill discovery, quality uplift, or an executed outcome
consumer: AgentOps maintainers deciding whether canonical premortem guidance changes which plan defects an agent returns before implementation
gate: the canonical-skill treatment is not called behaviorally effective without a banded, seeded-hit finding act
observed_defect: the two checks the skill puts ahead of technical risk: who verifies and are they fresh, and reversibility asserted rather than traced
retirement: delete with premortem, or when the headroom gate classifies this scenario SATURATED
